transport: No generic executable dispatcher is implemented by this contract
governing_rules: Source catalogue identity, ownership and grouping are ground truth
Accepted predecessor determines actual copper, walls, gaps and clearance
A later stage cannot undo accepted earlier work except through an explicitly authorized owning-stage correction
Prepare immutable operands once; keep mutable candidate/decision state separate
No tolerance, source coverage, pin separation, clearance or final export check may be weakened for caching

binding.rule: All refs bind exact bytes; record runtime/implementation compatibility for persistent reuse

geometry_record.rule: Lossless storage only; unsupported precision falls back to exact construction

neighbor_record.rule: Candidate lists are broad phase only. Exact predicates still run. Changes in membership or query bounds invalidate them.

dependency_record.rule: Only proven-local work may use affected-neighbor-only validation. Global or unproven dependencies retain complete checks.

checkpoint_record.rule: Atomic publication after referenced artifacts are complete; no accepted proposal may be lost or replayed as new work

propose.rule: Query both removed and added extents and every policy-required influence region; discover newly affected neighbors

check.rule: A cached operand is not a verdict. Reusing a check witness requires an adapter-qualified complete matching dependency binding; otherwise run the exact checker.

requires: All applicable checks pass against the current accepted state

effects: Retain failed proposal and check evidence; no alternate representation may bypass rejection

checkpoint.rule: Requires an explicitly implemented adapter; T02 persistent resume is NOT_IMPLEMENTED

resume.rule: Reject mismatch/corruption; never claim a recorded decision was freshly re-evaluated

finalize.rule: Retain complete final validation and all corruption/export checks; no full run is authorized by this design

agent_loop: Inspect existing bound receipts and task status
Prepare or restore immutable operands only under the matching binding
Execute permitted proposal checks against current accepted state
Persist decisions and dependencies only through the implemented owning adapter
Measure setup, cache restore, local checking and final validation separately
Report exact parity, differences, failures and supported limits; wait for authorization before scope expansion
forbidden: Treating this design as a runnable API
Using source copper in place of accepted predecessor copper
Starting a full-board run or replay without authorization
